scope: 300 reruns only original calls with any failed candidate; 1000 reruns only selected failures remaining at300. Other calls are unchanged. Success does not establish global optimality; unflagged local minima and all original-success calls were not budget-stressed. No primary confirmatory result is overwritten.

cp_model_audit.formula: vhat=sum|n_cp-n_tail|^2/(2*64); 64 independent complex differences with variance2v
cp_model_audit.clean_pairs: CP indices12..15 paired with useful60..63, maxdelay<=12, CP16
cp_model_audit.dependence: CP statistic shares useful-tail receiver noise with pilot/data FFT observations; not independent of them
cp_model_audit.assumptions: Ideal synchronized block-static point-path channel, white receiver noise, no extra front-end filter memory. Gains can differ across calibration blocks; all64 noise differences remain independent under this model.
